name: Context7
summary: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for software libraries, served to coding agents through a REST API, a hosted MCP server and a CLI. Search and docs calls answer with no account at a quota the server names in a header.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-23 with no credentials: an MCP initialize, a tools/list and a tools/call that returned ranked library ids all answered 200, and keyless REST calls answer 200 carrying context7-quota-tier: anonymous with ratelimit-limit 200.

jobs.summary: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for software libraries, delivered into the prompts of AI coding agents through a REST API, a hosted MCP server and a CLI, addressed as /{org}/{project} with an optional version tag.

Docs7's Context7 Agent edits a connected GitHub repository's configured docs path and opens a pull request with fixes for queued suggestions or build issues; the Gerrit integration commits generated code documentation to refs/for/{branch} for review. Vendor's claim, account-gated, not measured.

Docs7's PR Review Agent reviews the files inside a configured docs path in each eligible pull request for broken links, new build-health issues, grammar and (optionally) repository conventions, and posts its findings in the pull request. Vendor's claim, docs files only, not measured.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-23: nothing prices a call to an agent. The plans page names prices ($10/seat, $10 per 1,000 extra calls, $5 per 1M tokens parsed) and 'adding a payment method', but no page a signed-out reader can reach names an instrument, so humanBilling is unknown rather than guessed.
